name: Montenegrin Residence Permit
description: Residence permit card issued to foreigners in Montenegro; front and back sides.
acceptance_criteria: Both sides of the card must be fully visible, edges not cut off
All three MRZ lines on the back must be legible

appearance.layout: Card, landscape; on the front the photo is on the left, labelled lines on the right

field_locations.location: on the front, right of the photo, first line
top right corner of the front

appearance.side_differences: Photo and personal fields on the front; MRZ on the back
